lane: vent-structural (contrarian lane, distinct from h19-5 off-catalogue family)
hypothesis: Concealed geothermal faults are most probable where Quaternary fault traces, young volcanism, and surface fluid indicators (paleo-springs / 2 m geothermal probes) co-occur — step-overs, relay ramps, and volcanic-fed blind structures. Placing dots on this additive structural score (0.5×qfaults + 0.3×volcanics + 0.2×fluid) targets the domain where the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue is most likely incomplete, unlike the h19-5 family which only prunes catalogue-proximal dots.
mechanism: Additive structural score from five public USGS/DOE external layers (derived_gdr_qfaults_v2_100m_u8, derived_gdr_volcanics_100m_u8, derived_gdr_paleo_100m_u8, derived_gdr_2m_probes_100m_u8, derived_sgmc_faults_100m_u8), all on the 3730×3292 EPSG:32611 100 m grid. Top 37,654 pixels by score become dots (value 1.0), everything else 0.0, NaN outside footprint. Deterministic seed 7.
named_non_fault_process: Erosional fan scarps, paleoshoreline features, non-fault lithologic boundaries, and volcanic flow fronts can mimic fault proximity and radiometric/fluid indicators, producing false positives on the structural score.
